listenings.text: Good evening, ladies and gentlemen. Flight 506 to Sao Paulo is going to board in twenty minutes, at gate B12. The flight is going to take about twelve hours. We are going to serve dinner after take-off and breakfast before landing. Please have your passport and boarding pass ready. Thank you.

Hi, it's Klaus from Munich. I have big news. Next year, I'm going to open a second shop. It's going to be near the airport, and it's going to have eight lifts. And in March, I'm going to visit Brazil for the first time. I'm going to see the auto parts fair in Sao Paulo. I'm not going to stay long, only one week.

extra_audio.text: Laura is going to travel to Brazil in March. First, she is going to take a flight from Munich to Sao Paulo. Then she is going to visit an auto parts fair. After the fair, she is going to meet customers at their repair shops. On the last day, she is going to do some sightseeing and buy souvenirs.

paras: Laura, the sales manager at Kessler Brakes, has big plans. In March, she is going to travel abroad for work. She is going to visit Brazil for the first time. Her flight from Munich to Sao Paulo is twelve hours long.

In Sao Paulo, she is going to visit a big auto parts fair. She is going to talk to many shop owners, and she is going to have a meeting with her customers from the south of Brazil. She isn't going to stay in a big hotel. She is going to stay in a small hotel near the fair.

On the last day, she is going to do some sightseeing. She is going to try Brazilian food and buy souvenirs for her family. Is she going to learn some Portuguese? Yes, she is: she is going to learn ten words before the trip. Her suitcase is going to be very heavy on the way back!
